title: Wilderra
description: Wilderra is a great DLC like expansion for minecraft
body:
## This mod is in a early beta phase. Please Join the Discord server to report bugs and get leaks for other mods

Wilderra is a major content expansion mod. it focusues on adding more "Exotic" content to minecraft!

exploring the jarate chasm in the nether! with new plants and being able to craft the throwable jarate and or Just explore the Strange Sporewood Biome... and encounter the Magmadon in the nether!?
Or maybe trade with the cenozoic dealer!

Or explore the Tundra a new taiga like biome but larger! 
use new tools, encounter new biomes, new mobs and more!

Tame the new 3 ghastlings. warped, crimson and magma ghasts! quite rare mobs but once found you can tame them and ride them! (they require the biomes main food, for magma ghast it wants magma block)

so can you handle the expansion of Wilderra
